## Startup, in source order

- Set `app` to the instance provided for `Application`.
- Call [`Application.start`](domain/app.aug.md#symbol-Application.start) on `app`.
- Set `names` to a map with `1` mapped to `"apple"`; `2` mapped to `"pear"`.
- Select the matching case for call `get` on `names` with `key` = `2`:
  - A null value, including omitted optional input:
    - Call `print` with `value` = `"missing fruit"`.
  - A present, non-null value, named `name`:
    - Call `print` with `value` = `name`.
- Split a tuple containing `3`, `"plum"` into `code`, `label`, in that order.
- Call `print` with `value` = call `length` on a set containing call [`Fruit`](domain/models.aug.md#symbol-Fruit) with `code` = `code`; `name` = `label`, call [`Fruit`](domain/models.aug.md#symbol-Fruit) with `name` = `label`; `code` = `code`.
- Create a dependency and task scope. Join its child tasks and release scoped values before leaving:
  - Set `counter` to the instance provided for `Counter`.
  - Grant exclusive mutable access to `counter` for this block, then end the borrow:
    - Call [`Counter.increment`](counters.aug.md#symbol-Counter.increment) on `counter`.
  - Call `print` with `value` = call [`Counter.value`](counters.aug.md#symbol-Counter.value) on `counter`.
- Try these operations:
  - Call `print` with `value` = call [`double`](domain/numbers.aug.md#symbol-double) with `amount` = `7`.
  - Call [`double`](domain/numbers.aug.md#symbol-double) with `amount` = `-1`.
- If they fail with [`RangeError`](domain/numbers.aug.md#symbol-RangeError), name the failure `error` and recover:
  - Call `print` with `value` = `"negative amount rejected"`.
